Date : 19-01-2023 Heard Mr. A. Rahman, learned counsel for the accused-petitioner and Mr. M.P.
Goswami, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent State of Assam.

2. By this application under Section 439, Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, Page No.# 2/2 the accused-petitioner viz. Md. Usman Ali has prayed for his release on bail in connection with Gingia Police Station Case no. 75/2022 [corresponding G.R. Case no. 418/2022], registered for offence Md. Usman Ali vs The State Of Assam on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110166571/
1 under Section 376, Indian Penal Code [IPC].
3.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Mr. Goswami, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has submitted that after completion of investigation in connection with Gingia Police Station Case no. 75/2022, the Investigating Officer [I.O.] of the case has submitted a charge sheet under Section 173[2], CrPC being Charge Sheet no.
96/2022 dated 30.11.2022.
4.

In view of the submission of the charge sheet in the case, Mr. Rahman, learned counsel for the accused-petitioner has submitted that the accused- petitioner will approach the learned jurisdictional trial court seeking regular bail.
5. In view of the said submission of Mr. Rahman, this application stands closed, granting liberty to the accused-petitioner to approach the learned jurisdictional trial Court.

6. In the event the accused-petitioner approaches the learned jurisdictional trial court by filing any application seeking regular bail, the learned jurisdictional trial court shall consider such application on its own merits and in accordance with law.
